significance.basis: Resolves key foundational questions in variational quantum computation regarding trainability, barren plateaus, and exact rational certification, enabling polynomial-time pre-execution screening without quantum shots.

potential_errors: Minor typographical notes in equation alignments or cross-references are entirely absent from formal proofs due to complete Lean 4 machine-checking.

summary: The paper presents a definitive framework for exact-Q rational variance laws, Majorana Hodge-chiral selection rules, and machine-checked trainability certificates in compact Lie-group quantum circuits. By deriving exact rational identities over Q for 2-design circuits across SO(2n) matchgates and U(1) Hamming-weight-conserving circuits, the author resolves longstanding open questions regarding trainability beyond the dynamical Lie algebra, fine-grained real-irrep selection rules, and zero-shot verification. All core theorems are formally verified in Lean 4 without axioms or sorries, and operationalized via a zero-float exact-Q verifier.
weaknesses: The current framework assumes multiplicity-free real irreducible representations and exact 2-designs; extending automated norm extraction directly from arbitrary Hamiltonians remains an open direction for future work.
